summary: American Tower Corporation filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of Senior Notes due 2033. The notes are unsecured obligations ranking equally with other senior unsecured debt and are structurally subordinated to subsidiary debt. Interest is payable cash annually starting September 2026, with maturity in September 2033. Optional redemption is permitted at set prices, plus a tax redemption provision. The issuer intends to list on NYSE within 30 days of issuance. Proceeds will support general corporate purposes. This is a plain-vanilla debt offering with no special-situation characteristics like acquisition financing, restructuring, or capital return.
